name: CSV VLANs
description: VLANs of an IS from a CSV (number, name, address range): choose the VLANs to bring and the zone of each
author: Solid Geeks

file.label: Import VLANs from a CSV
file.help: One VLAN per line: its number, its name and its address range (CIDR), in any order, with or without a header (number, vlan or vid; name or nom; cidr, subnet, network or réseau; optionally zone). Separated by commas, semicolons or tabs.

pick.title: Choose the VLANs and their zone
pick.help: Tick the VLANs to bring into the IS and choose the zone of each, or of all the ticked ones at once. A VLAN already in the IS (same number) is updated when ticked.

fields.label: Without a choice (from a script): also update the VLANs already in the IS
Zone when none is chosen nor given by the file (its name; empty: the top zone of the IS)
